events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the nurture build script, list sequence files, and outline pre.md
events.input: $ cat workshop-plan/sequences/build_nurture.py | head -80; echo ---; ls -la workshop-plan/sequences/ cloud/src/generated/ | head -30; echo ---; git log --oneline -4 -- workshop-plan/sequences/pre.md workshop-plan/sequences/post.md cloud/src/generated/nurture-copy.ts workshop-plan/sequences/build_nurture.py; echo ---; grep -n '^#\|{{' workshop-plan/sequences/pre.md | head -90

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read setup spec, nurture code head, and generated copy head
events.input: $ sed -n 1,60p workshop-plan/sequences/campaign-setup.md; echo ---; sed -n 1,100p cloud/src/nurture.ts; echo ---; wc -c cloud/src/generated/nurture-copy.ts; head -c 1500 cloud/src/generated/nurture-copy.ts

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show build script body, copy file history, pre.md headings and placeholder counts
events.input: $ sed -n 25,70p workshop-plan/sequences/build_nurture.py | cut -c1-260; echo ---LOG; git log --format='%h %ad %s' --date=short -3 -- workshop-plan/sequences/pre.md | cut -c1-120; git log --format='%h %ad %s' --date=iso -2 -- cloud/src/generated/nurture-copy.ts | cut -c1-120; git status --short workshop-plan/sequences cloud/src/generated; echo ---HEADS; grep -n '^## \|^### \|^# ' workshop-plan/sequences/pre.md; echo ---PH; grep -o '{{[A-Za-z_0-9]*}}' workshop-plan/sequences/pre.md workshop-plan/sequences/post.md | sort | uniq -c

events.name: Bash
events.head: Rebuild generated copy, check drift, merge tags, lane differences, and field sources
events.input: $ python3 workshop-plan/sequences/build_nurture.py && git status --short cloud/src/generated && echo "---tags used"; grep -o '{{[A-Za-z_.0-9]*}}' cloud/src/generated/nurture-copy.ts | sort | uniq -c; echo "---free2 vs paid2"; diff <(sed -n 79,114p workshop-plan/sequences/pre.md) <(sed -n 245,280p workshop-plan/sequences/pre.md) | cut -c1-400; echo "---fieldsFor"; grep -n 'fieldsFor' cloud/src/*.ts | head; grep -n 'session_time\|cohort_dates\|join_day1\|vip_url\|day1_label\|calendar_url\|centre_url\|replay_day\|pro_course_url\|tantra_plan_url\|enterprise_url' cloud/src/reminders.ts cloud/src/nu

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the nurture probe header for run instructions

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check whether local centre and simulator are up and how they are started
events.input: $ (curl -s -o /dev/null -m 3 -w 'centre %{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:18890/ ; curl -s -o /dev/null -m 3 -w 'sim %{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:18892/); grep -n 'ADMIN_KEY' app/scripts/probe-nurture.mjs | head -5 | cut -c1-200; grep -ln '18890' app/scripts/*.sh cloud/scripts/* 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n '18890\|18892' app/scripts/run-chain.sh | head -8 | cut -c1-220

events.text: Checked that the generated campaign copy matches `pre.md` (no drift, all merge tags mapped). Now starting a local centre and simulator to re-run the nurture probe.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find how the local centre and vendor simulator are launched
events.input: $ grep -rn '18892' --include=*.sh --include=*.json --include=*.md --include=*.py --include=*.toml -l . 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -8; grep -n 'argparse\|--port\|PORT\|sys.argv' cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | head -6 | cut -c1-200; grep -n '"dev\|"scripts"' -A6 cloud/package.json | head -14; grep -n 'TANTRA\|18892' cloud/wrangler.toml cloud/wrangler*.toml 2>/dev/null | head -8 | cut -c1-200

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find the exact local launch commands used in past runs
events.input: $ grep -o 'wrangler dev[^"\\]\{0,260\}' workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-123.json workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-052.json 2>/dev/null | sort -u | tail -6; grep -o 'SIM_PORT=[^"\\]\{0,200\}' workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-123.json workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-052.json 2>/dev/null | sort -u | tail -4; ls cloud/ | head -30; grep -rn 'TANTRA_BASE\|VENDOR_SIM\|TANTRA_API' cloud/src/connectors/stack.ts | head -5 | cut -c1-220

events.name: Bash
events.head: List cloud scripts and see how the centre is pointed at the simulator
events.input: $ ls cloud/scripts | head -30; grep -n 'export function tantraUrl' -A8 cloud/src/connectors/stack.ts | cut -c1-240; grep -rln '18890' app/scripts cloud/scripts workshop-plan/ops 2>/dev/null | head -8; grep -n 'SIM\b\|SIM}' app/scripts/probe-nurture.mjs | sed -n 1,12p | cut -c1-220

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the local stack and dev launch scripts
events.input: $ cat cloud/scripts/local-stack.sh | cut -c1-240 | head -60; echo ---; cat cloud/scripts/run-dev.sh | cut -c1-240 | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start an isolated local centre and simulator on probe ports with a throwaway database
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud && test -f .dev.vars && echo devvars-present; grep -n 'database_name\|migrations_dir\|"binding"' wrangler.jsonc | head -6; P=/tmp/t052-probe; rm -rf $P; mkdir -p $P; DB=$(grep -o '"database_name": *"[^"]*"' wrangler.jsonc | head -1 | sed 's/.*: *"//;s/"//'); echo y | npx wrangler d1 migrations apply "$DB" --local --persist-to $P/state --config wrangler.jsonc > $P/mig.log 2>&1; tail -3 $P/mig.log | cut -c1-200

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the nurture probe against the isolated local stack
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app && CENTRE=http://127.0.0.1:18890 SIM=http://127.0.0.1:18892 node scripts/probe-nurture.mjs > /tmp/t052-probe/probe.log 2>&1; echo "exit $?"; grep -c '^PASS' /tmp/t052-probe/probe.log; grep -v '^PASS' /tmp/t052-probe/probe.log | head -20 | cut -c1-300

events.text: Probe passed 30 of 30. Stopping the throwaway local stack and recording the result on the board.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Stop the probe stack, confirm no code drift, set task status and acknowledge the note
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && pkill -f 'wrangler dev.*--port 18890' ; pkill -f 'workerd.*18890'; lsof -ti tcp:18892 | xargs kill 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; curl -s -o /dev/null -m 2 -w 'centre %{http_code} ' http://127.0.0.1:18890/; curl -s -o /dev/null -m 2 -w 'sim %{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:18892/; rm -rf /tmp/t052-probe/state; git status --short cloud/src workshop-plan/sequences app/scripts/probe-nurture.mjs

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check which simulator processes are running
events.input: $ pkill -f 'vendor-sim.py' -u "$(id -u)" 2>/dev/null; ps ax -o pid,command | grep '[v]endor-sim.py' | cut -c1-160

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check that the probe simulator is stopped and the shared dev simulator is still healthy

events.name: Bash
events.head: Confirm when the shared simulator restarted and that its state is intact
events.input: $ date; ps -o pid,ppid,lstart,command -p 3255 | cut -c1-200; curl -s -m 3 http://127.0.0.1:8792/__state | head -c 150; cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && git status --short cloud/src workshop-plan/sequences | head
